name: standard-profile-adoption
goal: Normal root and workspace test entrypoints record current source operations when verification requests evidence, while preserving worker limits and lazy startup.

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: The verified source adapter and runners exist, but the shared adoption boundary returns no plugins. Normal root and inherited workspace tests return correct results with no observations.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Extend existing workspace configuration acceptance with requested profiling through real root and inherited configs. Each run must add its own latency and memory captures; source code comes from the registered fixture only.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed2833131e red39584045: normal tests pass but the capture assertion reports false. Five pre-existing workspace startup/worker cases remain green.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Enable the shared adoption boundary through the installed Vite TS loader. Keep runner configs frozen, lazily load internal tooling only for requested evidence, and preserve original source addresses.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: All six unchanged workspace cases pass; root and inherited runs each retain fresh latency and memory. Types, product lint, audit and registry checks pass. Full-project verification remains pending.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.

Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
